channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Aug 18
item.description:
17 development commits

Weapon & Item Visual Updates

  • Optimized Salvaged Hammer textures: AO reduced from 2 K to 512 px; texture naming aligned to new convention (hammer_bc).
  • Fixed third‑person view offset for the Salvaged Hammer.
  • Updated Laserlight world model and made its LOD component more forgiving.
  • Adjusted muzzle brake and muzzle boost LOD switching to be smoother and distance‑consistent.

Environment & Collision Optimizations

  • Replaced multiple box colliders on Jungle Ziggurat Treatment Tank with a single mesh collider for better performance.
  • Fixed mountability of static chairs on the gas‑station roof by correcting a slight ground clipping issue.

Multiplayer & Editor Fixes

  • Resolved pink rendering bug in Multi‑Client Play Mode caused by missing package folder cloning.

Render Pipeline Tweaks (internal testing)

  • Added radial blur to the RRP, optimized combined blur, and set up explosion volume and overlay.
  • Reduced the vignette effect strength in the RRP.

Livestock & Animal Systems

  • Implemented sleeping animation for sheep and prevented animals from moving while sleeping.
  • Added new livestock species assets, enabling separate male/female prefabs for cows and sheep.
  • Imported all dog assets (models, materials, animations, prefabs, harnesses) from the legacy Pets2 branch.

Vehicle Pooling Improvements

  • Fixed additional child‑pooling issues, specifically handling of OnParentDestroying.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Aug 17
item.description:
48 development commits

Nexus Server Enhancements

  • Tagged servers with Nexus enabled using nexuszone and exposed Nexus info in A2S rules.
  • Added option to hide Nexus zones from the server list (nexus.hideZones).
  • Fixed map button activation on the connect modal for Nexus paths.
  • Resolved map UI squishing after recent changes.
  • Applied miscellaneous Nexus connect‑modal UI fixes.
  • Corrected MaxPlayers value after Nexus modifications.

UI & Editor Improvements

  • Redesigned Demo UI sandbox panel with parenting, revamped color picker, and key‑framed light intensity/range.
  • Added scroll fade/gradient to Demo UI tabs and fixed left‑offset alignment on non‑keyframable rows.
  • Sorted F1 menu category buttons alphabetically by translated label.
  • Editor multiplayer: final name cleanup, performance‑logging NRE fix, hot‑reload fix, custom scenario dropdown, crosshair NRE fix, and additional second‑client NRE fixes.
  • Updated conditional model handling to respect null slots and refresh only when changed.

Stability & Performance Fixes

  • Implemented threaded‑log handler so messages from other threads appear in console and RCON.
  • Added tests confirming threaded‑log fix and captured exceptions from async tasks.
  • Detached parented children before entering vehicle pool to stop NRE spamming.
  • Prevented rooms from hiding until invisible for 5 seconds, reducing churn.
  • Relocated file‑storage code to avoid unload during domain reload (SQLite clan fix).

Animal & Livestock Updates

  • Added bull prefab setup.
  • Fixed all livestock being set to female and introduced breeding FSM states.

IO & Power System Refactor (Hackweek)

  • Fixed battery ReceiveAdditionalData client RPC and removed legacy IO code from the battery class.
  • Converted CCTV cameras, windmills, water wheel, Tesla coil, SolarPanel, and FuelGenerator; added dummy‑switch power slots.
  • Simplified battery console commands and added related tests.
  • Disabled Unsafe.UseMultithreadedScripting on client and added tests for safe booting in both client and server modes.

Asset & Rendering Fixes

  • Fixed underwater labs window refraction texture with RRP.
  • Added white boomer firework variant (new colour, icon, and PFX) to avoid misleading pack icon.
  • Fixed jungle loot‑box gib material and crate_basic gib colliders; re‑exported crate_basic with zeroed scale.
  • Removed unnecessary prefab and introduced per‑face physics‑material test cube.
  • Reverted previous color‑picker fix and applied an improved solution.
